title: Friends turned away from Area 51

tellings.quote: Recently, my friends were in the United States and wanted to drive up there to take a look. But when they drove up, the military didn't let them through.

plain: Friends who recently drove up to Area 51, a secret US military base in Nevada, just to look were stopped by soldiers and not let through. A Russian regional leader named Kiran Ilum Xenov tells this, passing on what his friends told him. He raises it as a sign of how closely the site is guarded.
